events.text: Hülkenberg was confirmed as Williams reserve driver for the season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 26 January 2011 , Hülkenberg was confirmed as Williams reserve driver for the season

events.text: Force India announced di Resta and Hülkenberg would be their drivers for the 2012 season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 16 December 2011 , Force India announced di Resta and Hülkenberg would be their drivers for the 2012 season .

events.text: Hülkenberg finished fifth in the 2012 Brazilian Grand Prix.
events.subject: self

events.text: Sauber confirmed they had signed Hülkenberg for the 2013 season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 31 October 2012 Sauber confirmed they had signed Hülkenberg for the 2013 season
